multiChannelBanner.bold: Use each booking link on a different channel.
multiChannelBanner.body: One design on your Instagram profile, another on your website, a third in your email signature – every channel can have its own. Clients always land on your page, just with a different look.

classic.name: Classic
classic.subtitle: Simple and clean
classic.description: Classic design with elegant gradient backgrounds. Ideal for showcasing your brand colors and building a recognizable identity.

modern.name: Modern
modern.subtitle: Contemporary and dynamic
modern.description: Contemporary design with a dark background and vibrant accents. We recommend a darker primary color for the best visual effect and a premium feel.

elegant.name: Elegant
elegant.subtitle: Clean and minimal
elegant.description: Luxurious minimalist design with soft earthy tones. Perfect for upscale salons, spas, and exclusive services.

seasonal.name: Seasonal
seasonal.subtitle: Adaptive and vibrant
seasonal.description: Dynamic design that automatically adapts to the season and holidays. Spring, summer, autumn, winter, Christmas, Valentine's Day, Halloween and more – your page is always fresh and relevant.

magazine.name: Magazine
magazine.subtitle: Elegant and editorial
magazine.description: Premium Magazine design with editorial aesthetics and high-quality visual style. Ideal for exclusive salons, beauty studios, and premium services.

casino.name: Casino
casino.subtitle: Glamorous and exciting
casino.description: Exclusive casino design with a glamorous atmosphere, sparkling accents, and dynamic visual elements. Perfect for those who want to turn appointment booking into an unforgettable experience.
